panels.title: Delivered (window)
panels.description: Successful deliveries in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM webhook_deliveries WHERE $__timeFilter(delivered_at)

panels.title: Dead-lettered (window)
panels.description: Webhooks that exhausted retries or permanently failed, in range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM dead_letter_queue WHERE $__timeFilter(abandoned_at)

panels.title: Queue depth (now)
panels.description: Live jobs in graphile_worker: ready = runnable now, in-flight = locked by a worker, scheduled = waiting on retry backoff.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE locked_at IS NULL AND run_at <= now()) AS ready, count(*) FILTER (WHERE locked_at IS NOT NULL) AS "in-flight", count(*) FILTER (WHERE run_at > now()) AS scheduled FROM graphile_worker.jobs

panels.title: Success rate (window)
panels.description: delivered / (delivered + dead-lettered) over the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * d.c / nullif(d.c + f.c, 0), 2) AS value FROM (SELECT count(*) c FROM webhook_deliveries WHERE $__timeFilter(delivered_at)) d, (SELECT count(*) c FROM dead_letter_queue WHERE $__timeFilter(abandoned_at)) f

panels.title: Throughput — delivered vs dead-lettered
panels.description: Counts bucketed over time. Delivered keyed on delivered_at, failures on abandoned_at.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(delivered_at, $__interval), count(*) AS delivered FROM webhook_deliveries WHERE $__timeFilter(delivered_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(abandoned_at, $__interval), count(*) AS "dead-lettered" FROM dead_letter_queue WHERE $__timeFilter(abandoned_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sent → received latency (delivery time)
panels.description: End-to-end queue+delivery latency per bucket: delivered_at - enqueued_at. avg and max.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(delivered_at, $__interval), avg(extract(epoch FROM delivered_at - enqueued_at)) AS "avg latency", max(extract(epoch FROM delivered_at - enqueued_at)) AS "max latency" FROM webhook_deliveries WHERE $__timeFilter(delivered_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latency percentiles (window)
panels.description: Distribution of sent→received latency over the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM delivered_at - enqueued_at)) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM delivered_at - enqueued_at)) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM delivered_at - enqueued_at)) AS p99 FROM webhook_deliveries WHERE $__timeFilter(delivered_at)

panels.title: Failure modes (window)
panels.description: Dead-letter reasons. Old rows with no reason recorded show as 'unknown'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(failure_reason, ''), 'unknown') AS reason, count(*) AS count FROM dead_letter_queue WHERE $__timeFilter(abandoned_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Retry distribution — attempts by outcome
panels.description: Attempts taken to reach a terminal state. delivered/dead-lettered come from the stored attempts column (populated for new traffic; old rows predate it); in-flight is current graphile_worker jobs. A right-shifted distribution means endpoints are forcing retries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT attempt, sum(delivered) AS delivered, sum(dead_lettered) AS "dead-lettered", sum(in_flight) AS "in-flight" FROM ( SELECT attempts AS attempt, count(*) AS delivered, 0 AS dead_lettered, 0 AS in_flight FROM webhook_deliveries WHERE attempts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT attempts, 0, count(*), 0 FROM dead_letter_queue WHERE attempts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT attempts, 0, 0, count(*) FROM graphile_worker.jobs GROUP BY 1 ) t GROUP BY attempt ORDER BY attempt

panels.title: Bad endpoints — failure leaderboard (all time)
panels.description: Destinations ranked by failures, with fail %. High-cardinality by design — this is why it lives in SQL, not a Prometheus label.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dest AS destination, sum(delivered) AS delivered, sum(failed) AS failed, round(100.0 * sum(failed) / nullif(sum(delivered) + sum(failed), 0), 1) AS "fail %" FROM ( SELECT destination AS dest, count(*) AS delivered, 0 AS failed FROM webhook_deliveries GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT destination, 0, count(*) FROM dead_letter_queue GROUP BY 1 ) t GROUP BY dest ORDER BY failed DESC, "fail %" DESC LIMIT 25
